title: Living In The Moment
subtitle: Live Like a Cat - Right Here, Right Meow!
bodyHtml:
Hey human.

Cats are pros at living in the moment:

We don’t think about yesterday’s hairballs.
We don’t stress about tomorrow’s vet appointment.
We only care about right now.

Sunbeam? Let's sunbathe. Nap time? We nap.

Humans, though… you get stuck.

“Why did I say that?” (past)
“What if something bad happens?” (future)

But the past is over. The future hasn’t happened.
The only time you can actually enjoy is right now.

  • - Take a deep breath.
  • - Feel your feet on the ground.
  • - Notice the light, the sounds, the little things.

Your brain doesn’t have to be everywhere all the time.
Sometimes the softest peace is just… being here.
Right here. Right meow.
